messages:
Maria: Posting follow-ups from the PM/SE postmortem — we need owners and concrete timelines for the rollout/canary/flag improvements. Quick answers please so we can close the action items. Link to postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-2874

Derek: I can own the auto-rollback implementation and the short-term metric alerts.

Maria: Thanks @Derek. Can you call out an ETA and any blockers?

Derek: ETA = 2026-04-10 for a beta rollout on staging. Blockers: need a small API change to expose per-route health counters (I'll open a PR).

Raj: I'll take blast-radius controls for feature flags (rate limits + region scoping). Plan: produce a proposal by 2026-03-30 and a config schema PR by 2026-04-06.

Sophia: I'll own the canary metric definitions and the dashboards for SLO-driven rollouts. Will add dashboard links and alert playbook.

infra-bot: Deployment window available: 2026-04-09 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). Please add runbook entries before scheduling.

Maria: For tracking: JIRA tickets to be created per owner. Derek -> JIRA-4523, Raj -> JIRA-4524, Sophia -> JIRA-4525. Put timelines in the ticket.

Derek: Drafted config we plan to support (example):
```json
{
  "policy": "auto_rollback",
  "enabled": true,
  "failure_rate_threshold": 0.03,
  "sampling_window_seconds": 300,
  "min_requests": 200,
  "blast_radius_percent": 2
}
```

Tim: Question — what's the acceptance criteria for rollback? Is it strictly failure rate or include latency regressions?

Sophia: Include both. Acceptance = failure rate > threshold OR p95 latency > baseline + 50ms for the sampling window. We'll add a composite alert.

Emma: Ops note — please ensure the auto-rollback action logs the chosen rollback variant + reason and emits a telemetry event. We need that for post-rollback forensics.

Derek: Will emit `rollback.triggered` with fields: route, model_version, reason, metric_snapshot.

Maria: Ownership summary: Derek = auto-rollback (JIRA-4523) ETA 2026-04-10, Raj = flag blast-radius + region gating (JIRA-4524) ETA 2026-04-06, Sophia = canary metric + dashboards (JIRA-4525) ETA 2026-03-30, Emma = telemetry/runbook updates (add to each JIRA).

Raj: Quick config sketch for flag gating (yaml):
```yaml
flag: staged_ship_v2
stages:
  - pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
  - pct: 5
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
  - pct: 25
    regions: all
safety:
  auto_rollback: true
  error_threshold: 0.02
  latency_threshold_ms: 50
```

Ops Oncall: Reminder — make sure feature flags default to OFF for internal orgs until tests pass. Also add a toggle to disable auto-rollback in emergency windows.

Maria: Can each owner post their JIRA link + first PR link in this thread when available? I will follow up in next ops sync (2026-04-12).

Derek: JIRA-4523 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-4523. PR for API change: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2789 (draft).

Raj: JIRA-4524 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-4524. Proposal doc: https://docs.redwood.com/flag-blast-radius-proposal (WIP).

Sophia: JIRA-4525 created and dashboard cards added.

Tim: Will schedule a brief smoke test plan with SRE for the staging rollout window.

Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem follow-up list and mark these items as "in progress". If anything slips beyond the ETA, please update the JIRA and ping me. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Reminder: please add `deployment-checklist` label to PRs that touch rollout or rollback logic.

Emma: Quick note — let's add a small post-deploy canary runbook step to run these commands:
```bash
# check recent errors
curl -s "https://internal-api/redwood/metrics?route=/generate&window=5m" | jq .errors
# verify p95
curl -s "https://internal-api/redwood/latency?route=/generate&window=5m" | jq .p95
```

Maria: Closing thread for now. Will bring status to ops sync and follow up if new blockers appear.
